decisive_items: necrotizing granulomatous inflammation without evidence of malignancy
cytoplasmic ANCA titre of 1 / 20 and a PR3 level of 14.6 IU ml−1
response.rationale: The presence of cytoplasmic ANCA and PR3, along with necrotizing granulomatous inflammation, strongly supports Wegener's granulomatosis over cavitating lung cancer, which was ruled out by biopsy results.

rejected.why: biopsy results showed no evidence of malignancy
